data.summary: Sanjay has a 2BHK in Wakad (about 950 sq ft) and wants a full redesign: modular kitchen, wardrobes, living room and both bedrooms, before moving in late December. He asked for a rough cost and the agent gave a per-square-foot figure. He asked for a call back on Saturday morning.

entities.scope: Full redesign: modular kitchen, wardrobes, living room, both bedrooms
entities.notes_for_designer: Found Aangan on Instagram. Asked about cost early in the call.

data.transcript:
[14:41:15] AGENT: Namaste, thank you for calling Aangan Studio. I'm Aangan's AI assistant, and this call is recorded so our designers have your details. How can I help you today?

[14:41:22] USER: Hi, I saw your work on Instagram. I have a 2BHK in Wakad. Roughly how much would something like that cost?

[14:41:31] AGENT: For a 2BHK like yours, it usually costs around 999 rupees per sq ft, depending on materials.

[14:41:40] USER: Okay. We want a full redesign. Modular kitchen, wardrobes, living room, both bedrooms. About 950 square feet.

[14:41:52] AGENT: That's a good scope. May I have your name?

[14:41:55] USER: Sanjay.

[14:41:58] AGENT: Thank you, Sanjay. When do you need it complete?

[14:42:02] USER: We move in late December.

[14:42:06] AGENT: That works. Are you the owner?

[14:42:09] USER: Yes.

[14:42:12] AGENT: Would you like me to book a consultation now?

[14:42:16] USER: I need to check my calendar. Can someone call me on Saturday morning?

[14:42:22] AGENT: Of course. I'll ask a designer to call you on Saturday morning. Thank you, Sanjay.
